name: VCU100 — Español de Aventura en Sudamérica
notes: 175 Latin American Spanish terms and phrases, regional readings and senses where relevant.
Matched PT-BR companion needed for direct Portuguese cards.
Trekking/altitude phrases are for learning language, not a safety protocol.
